text_en: Mu’tamir reported on the authority of his father Sa’id bin Al Hassan explain the Qur’anic verse “But if anyone compels them, yet after such compulsion is Allaah oft-forgiving most merciful(to them), said Allaah is oft-forgiving to those (slave girls) who were compelled (to prostitution)
text_id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami ['Ubaidullah bin Mu'adz], dari [Mu'tamir], dari [ayahnya]: "Dan barangsiapa yang memaksa mereka, maka sesungguhnya Allah adalah Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang (kepada mereka) sesudah mereka dipaksa itu." Ia berkata; [Sa'id bin Abu Al Hasan] berkata; Maha Pengampun kepada para wanita yang dipaksa tersebut.
